heroKicker: Finnish for YKI, work and everyday life
heroLead: Build practical Finnish with speaking practice, useful feedback and guidance in a language you already know.
transition: KieliValmis is the new customer-facing name for Floently Finnish. Your account, progress and subscription continue with the same service.
pathTitle: Learn the Finnish you need for the next step.
pathBody: Exam preparation, working-life communication and everyday Finnish belong in the same learning journey.
card1Body: Practise speaking, writing, reading and listening in realistic YKI-style tasks.
card2Body: Practise the conversations, questions and explanations you need in real working life.
card3Body: Finnish practice stays Finnish. Guidance and feedback can be shown in your chosen language.
ykiTitle: YKI practice that connects the skills.
ykiBody: Practise communication, review feedback and try again across all four subtests.
workTitle: Finnish for situations that actually happen at work.
workBody: Build vocabulary, grammar and speaking through realistic professional situations.
langKicker: Your language can help you learn Finnish
langBody: Choose the language you understand best for interface guidance, explanations and feedback.
langNote: The YKI exam itself is in Finnish or Swedish as defined by the official test. KieliValmis does not claim that the YKI exam is offered in 20 languages.
finalBody: Prepare for YKI, work and everyday Finnish in one connected learning experience.
